name: v3.26.0
body:
## What's Changed
* harden(save): sanitize --save-suffix into a path-safe token by @nate-avra in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/736
* Add consent-gated Windows MCP host controls by @Leit-motif in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/980
* fix(tests): exempt LAST30DAYS_MCP_ALLOW_BROWSER_COOKIES from the config contract by @ahhhdum in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1157
* chore(deps): bump zizmorcore/zizmor-action from 0.6.3 to 0.6.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1147
* chore(deps): bump github/codeql-action/upload-sarif from 4.37.9 to 4.38.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1148
* chore(deps): bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 10.0.1 to 10.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1149
* feat(perplexity): add --perplexity-search-type opt-in and bound HTTP error-body reads by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1187
* fix(perplexity): keep hosted routing without a direct key; never block Sonar on search type by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1188
* fix(reddit): keep keyless Reddit discovery working after the RSS shutdown by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1189
* chore(release): bump version to 3.26.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1190

## New Contributors
* @nate-avra made their first contribution in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/736
* @Leit-motif made their first contribution in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/980
* @ahhhdum made their first contribution in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1157

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/compare/v3.25.0...v3.26.0
